mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered periods (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) below their 12-month moving averages indicate weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both below 12-month moving average
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are below their 12-month moving averages, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 5%) indicates labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending and corporate profit growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production (INDPRO > 105) indicates robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO > 105, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Low housing starts (HOUST < 1000) signal a cooling housing market, reducing construction activity and consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST < 1000, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE increases > 0.2 percentage points in the last month) indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered periods (UNRATE increase > 0.2pp), or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high employment level (PAYEMS) relative to its 12-month moving average indicates a strong labor market, supporting consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS is above its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
